title: سلطة الأفوكادو بالبيض — Avocado & Egg Salad
style: Photorealistic food photography, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft warm natural window light from the left, light oak kitchen table, softly blurred warm home-kitchen background, realistic natural food textures, appetizing, sharp focus on the food. No text, no logos, no people.

scenes.tts: إذا بتحبي الأكل الصحي والطيب، عندي إلك وصفة رح تعجبك كتير.
captions: عندي إلك وصفة رح تعجبك كتير!

scenes.tts: حبة أفوكادو، ثلاث بيضات مسلوقات، حبة بطاطا مسلوقة، بقدونس وبصل أخضر.

shots.prompt: Overhead top-down flat-lay on a light oak table: one whole ripe avocado and one halved avocado, three peeled boiled eggs, one boiled potato, a bunch of flat-leaf parsley, three green onions, neatly arranged with space between them, soft daylight.
shots.must_show: an avocado, boiled eggs, a potato, parsley and green onions from above

shots.prompt: Close-up of two halves of a ripe Hass avocado, one with the pit, creamy green flesh, on a light wooden cutting board, a few water drops shimmering.
shots.must_show: a halved avocado

shots.prompt: Close-up of three peeled boiled eggs on a small cream ceramic plate, one cut in half showing a soft bright yellow yolk.
shots.must_show: boiled eggs, one cut in half with a yellow yolk

shots.prompt: Close-up of one boiled potato with golden skin, a thin ribbon of steam, one half cut open showing fluffy pale yellow flesh, on a rustic wooden board.
shots.must_show: a boiled potato cut open

shots.prompt: Close-up of a fresh bunch of flat-leaf parsley and three green onions with white roots lying on a wooden board, water droplets on the leaves.
shots.must_show: parsley and green onions

shots.prompt: Overhead top-down flat-lay on a light oak table: one halved avocado, three boiled eggs, one boiled potato, parsley and green onions arranged around an empty cream ceramic bowl, soft daylight.
shots.must_show: avocado, eggs, potato, parsley, green onions around a bowl from above

scenes.tts: بنقطّع الأفوكادو والبيض والبطاطا لمكعبات، وبنفرم البقدونس والبصل الأخضر ناعم.

shots.prompt: Close-up of neatly diced ripe avocado cubes on a light wooden cutting board with a sharp chef's knife resting beside the cubes, no hands.
shots.must_show: diced avocado cubes on a cutting board with a knife

shots.prompt: Close-up of diced boiled egg and diced boiled potato in two neat piles on a light wooden cutting board, soft yellow yolk visible, no hands.
shots.must_show: diced egg and diced potato on a cutting board

shots.prompt: Macro of finely chopped fresh parsley on a light wooden cutting board with a chef's knife resting nearby, no hands.
shots.must_show: finely chopped parsley on a cutting board

shots.prompt: Macro of finely sliced green onion rings on a light wooden cutting board, no hands.
shots.must_show: sliced green onion rings

shots.prompt: Overhead top-down view of a wooden cutting board with neat separate piles of diced avocado, diced egg, diced potato, chopped parsley and sliced green onions.
shots.must_show: separate piles of diced avocado, egg, potato, parsley and green onion

scenes.tts: منحط كل المكونات بوعاء، ومنضيف عصرة ليمون، زيت زيتون، ملح وفلفل حسب الرغبة.

shots.prompt: Diced avocado, diced boiled egg, diced potato, chopped parsley and sliced green onion piled in a large clear glass mixing bowl on a light oak table, three-quarter view.
shots.must_show: diced avocado, egg, potato and herbs in a glass bowl

shots.prompt: A juicy lemon half held just above a clear glass mixing bowl of diced avocado, egg and potato, a single clear drop of lemon juice falling toward the salad.
shots.motion: A single drop of lemon juice falls into the bowl. The lemon half and the bowl stay still. Very slow gentle camera push-in.
shots.must_show: a lemon half above a glass bowl of diced avocado and egg

shots.prompt: Golden extra-virgin olive oil pouring in a thin steady stream from a small glass jug into a clear glass mixing bowl of diced avocado, egg and potato, oil glistening.
shots.motion: The olive oil keeps pouring in a thin steady stream into the bowl. The bowl stays still. Very slow gentle camera push-in.
shots.must_show: olive oil pouring into a glass bowl of diced avocado and egg

shots.prompt: Macro of coarse sea salt crystals and freshly cracked black pepper falling over diced avocado and egg in a glass bowl.
shots.must_show: salt and black pepper over diced avocado and egg

shots.prompt: Glass mixing bowl of dressed diced avocado, egg and potato glistening with olive oil and lemon, a wooden spoon resting in the bowl, three-quarter view.
shots.must_show: a glass bowl of dressed avocado and egg salad with a wooden spoon

scenes.tts: منقلّبهم بشويش، وهيك بتصير عنا سلطة كريمية، طيبة ومشبعة.

shots.prompt: Top-down view of a wooden spoon already gently folding creamy avocado and egg salad in a cream ceramic bowl on a light oak table.
shots.motion: The wooden spoon slowly folds the creamy salad over once with a smooth gentle motion. The bowl stays still. Slow camera push-in.
shots.must_show: a wooden spoon in a bowl of creamy avocado and egg salad from above

shots.prompt: Extreme macro close-up of creamy mashed avocado salad with chunks of boiled egg, potato and green onion, glossy and appetizing.
shots.motion: Very slow smooth push-in on the creamy salad. Everything else stays perfectly still.
shots.must_show: creamy avocado salad with chunks of egg

shots.prompt: Cinematic macro of the finished creamy avocado and egg salad with chopped parsley on top, glossy, in a cream ceramic bowl.
shots.must_show: finished creamy avocado and egg salad

shots.prompt: Overhead top-down of the finished avocado and egg salad in a cream ceramic bowl with a wooden spoon, a lemon wedge and a parsley sprig beside it on a light oak table.
shots.must_show: finished avocado and egg salad in a bowl from above

scenes.tts: جرّبيها واحكيلي شو رأيك، ولا تنسي تحفظي الوصفة.

shots.prompt: A silver spoon lifting a scoop of creamy avocado and egg salad out of a cream ceramic bowl, the salad piled on the spoon, warm window light.
shots.motion: The spoon lifts slowly and smoothly upward with the scoop of salad. The bowl stays still. Slow camera push-in.
shots.must_show: a spoon lifting a scoop of avocado and egg salad from a bowl

shots.prompt: Final beauty shot of the avocado and egg salad in a cream ceramic bowl with a silver spoon resting in it, a lemon half and a parsley sprig beside it, warm window light, three-quarter view.
shots.must_show: avocado and egg salad in a ceramic bowl with a spoon, lemon and parsley
